evals.name: cli-repo-first-kit
evals.prompt: This Rust CLI repo has no way for an agent to prove a change works beyond cargo test. Set up verification so the next agent can prove the snapshot command really works.
evals.expected_output: A .agents/verify kit with a real doctor and check, a snapshot driver that runs the built binary against a real page and asserts on output, a feature file with what usually lies, and proof that the driver fails on a broken state.
assertions: Scaffolds with scripts/scaffold.mjs instead of hand-writing the kit
check.sh runs the same commands CI runs
The driver exercises the built binary, not a unit test or mock
The driver is shown failing on a deliberately broken state and passing on the fixed one
Stops before committing the kit into a repo the user does not own

evals.name: wrong-surface-done-claim
evals.prompt: Last time an agent said the seat map flow did not exist after grepping the DOM and network tab. It was behind a login wall. Add verification for that flow so this cannot happen again.
evals.expected_output: A driver that screenshots the real screen after each step and asserts on visible state, a feature file whose What usually lies section names the silent auth wall, and an ENFORCERS row tying the rule to the driver.
assertions: The driver captures a screenshot and the agent looks at it
What usually lies names the auth wall that produces no network traffic
Adds an ENFORCERS.md row for the escaped mistake
doctor.sh fails with a clear reason when the required account is missing instead of faking it
